name: weekly: week not aligned to Monday
find: anchor -= timedelta(days=anchor.weekday())        # back to THIS week's Monday 8pm
replace: anchor -= timedelta(days=0)        # back to THIS week's Monday 8pm

name: weekly: current (unfinished) week not rolled back before Monday 8pm
find:
if anchor > now_ist:                              # this Monday 8pm not reached yet
        anchor -= WEEK

name: weekly trend: fewer than seven nested days
weekly trend: day window start off by one
weekly: received count no longer the week's own window
weekly options: not newest-first / wrong count of weeks
